theme: dark performance-pro with cinematic editorial cyber-security overlays

design_concepts.name: Web-Slinger Command Deck
design_concepts.description: Primary direction: a framed central viewport, crimson targeting marks, editorial identity copy, and quiet night-city depth. Mixes film title cards, tactical avionics HUDs, and screen-printed comic linework.

design_concepts.name: Archive of the Watcher
design_concepts.description: More restrained alternative: museum archive labels, forensic case folders, and monochrome security-monitor geometry with crimson evidence tags.

design_concepts.name: Midnight Rooftop Terminal
design_concepts.description: Terminal-first composition combining Linux shell culture, brutalist poster typography, and vertical city signage. Best when the portfolio should feel more technical than heroic.

design_concepts.name: Signal / Thread
design_concepts.description: Network topology becomes the visual language: skills and projects are connected as web strands, borrowing from circuit diagrams, spider silk, and subway maps.

design_concepts.name: Redline Field Notes
design_concepts.description: Hand-annotated dossier aesthetic using rough registration marks, redacted blocks, and notebook margins. Most personal and least conventional; use as a secondary mission-log treatment.

primary_tasks: Understand who Yash is in under 10 seconds
Reach Yash by phone or email
Explore the experience without losing usability
success_actions: Use the local WEB AI assistant
Copy an email address or call the phone number
discovery.emotional_arc: boot curiosity -> identity recognition -> evidence and competence -> trustworthy contact
discovery.content_rule: Only use supplied portfolio facts. Never invent employers, links, rankings, certifications, project outcomes, or claims. GitHub and LinkedIn remain visibly labeled ADD YOUR LINK.

research_descriptors.descriptor: Terminal HUDs, boot sequences, data cartridges, honeycomb or network motifs, and CSS fallback when WebGL is unavailable.
Cinematic scene changes, kinetic editorial type, brutalist structure, and GPU-assisted effects used selectively rather than as a full-screen effect.
Branch animation with prefers-reduced-motion; keep opacity and essential state changes, remove large sweeps and rapid flashing. gsap.matchMedia is suitable if GSAP is introduced.

typography.heading: Barlow Condensed, 900; uppercase, tracking-tighter, leading-none
typography.body: IBM Plex Sans, 400/500; left aligned, leading-relaxed
typography.mono: JetBrains Mono, 400/600; labels, telemetry, terminal, timestamps
rules: Do not use Inter, Roboto, Open Sans, Lato, Space Grotesk, or generic sans for headings
H1 maximum text-6xl; H2 maximum text-4xl; H3 maximum text-2xl
Overlines are uppercase text-xs with tracking-[0.2em]
Use large type as a film-title moment, but keep supporting copy at least text-xl when paired with a hero H1

colors.usage: Use near-black structural surfaces, crimson only for actions and targeting, blue only for secondary telemetry. No full-screen gradients and never pure #000000 or #808080.
colors.contrast: Verify normal text at 4.5:1 minimum and large text at 3:1 minimum; never put small text directly over the supplied images without a readable scrim.

visual_enhancers: Subtle CSS grain/noise overlay at low opacity
Scanlines using a restrained repeating-linear-gradient overlay, never over readable content
Targeting reticles and small blinking status dots with non-motion state alternatives
Layered panel shadows: ambient black plus a faint crimson edge
Custom cursor only on fine pointers; keep a visible browser cursor fallback

image_urls.description: Spider man 1.webp; main intro eye-catcher. Use object-cover with a light bg-black/30 to bg-black/50 directional scrim, preserving subject visibility.
Spider man 2.webp; optional mission transition or lower-page visual.
Hanging.jpe; hanging avatar in a contained viewport, with gentle pointer parallax and static fallback.

layouts.header: Visible desktop nav with YASH RAJ mark, SYSTEM, IDENTITY, MISSION DATABASE, ARSENAL, MISSION LOG, SECURE CHANNEL, and a primary CONTACT CTA. Solid panel or bg-void/90 backdrop-blur-xl; never transparent.
layouts.hero: Asymmetric 12-column Tetris grid: text and telemetry occupy md:col-span-4, framed image viewport md:col-span-8 row-span-2, leaving intentional breathing room. Mobile becomes one column with image max-h-[80vh].
layouts.content: Use cardless bordered dossier panels with p-6/p-8, mixed square/tall spans, and wide gap-8. Keep grid children direct children and align-items:start.
layouts.footer: Dark contrast-shift footer with py-20, large YASH RAJ mark, phone, two emails, and explicit ADD YOUR LINK placeholders for GitHub and LinkedIn.

grids.rule: Do not fill every cell; preserve offset negative space.

interaction_and_motion.startup: Boot sequence with skip button; sequence may animate opacity, scale, and scanline reveal, but must be skippable and shortened for reduced motion.
interaction_and_motion.entrance: Stagger panels by 60-100ms using opacity/translateY only; disable stagger under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.
interaction_and_motion.hover: Buttons and links use explicit hover text color, crimson border lift, and transform transition only; add active press scale.
interaction_and_motion.spider_sense: Toggle adds subtle cursor-proximate web lines and blue telemetry; provide aria-pressed and a static active indicator.
interaction_and_motion.sounds: Generated Web Audio interface sounds are OFF by default, require explicit user toggle, and never autoplay.
interaction_and_motion.fallbacks: CSS-only atmosphere if WebGL is unavailable; no core information depends on canvas or sound.

accessibility: All buttons, links, menus, assistant controls, toggles, project expanders, copy actions, contact values, status values, and download controls require data-testid in kebab-case.
Use semantic landmarks, heading order, visible focus rings, keyboard operability, aria-expanded on dossiers, aria-live on assistant responses, and aria-hidden on decorative web lines.
Respect prefers-reduced-motion and avoid flashing or rapid red/blue alternation.
Do not rely on color, sound, hover, or motion alone to communicate status.
Use readable solid or high-opacity surfaces behind all text; no complete transparent overlays or headers.
Customize scrollbar without creating a layout gutter.

media.loading: lazy-load below-fold images, explicit width/height or aspect ratio, decoding=async
media.hero: eager load the main intro image, preserve subject with object-position, and provide descriptive alt text
media.mobile: All images max-h-[80vh] on mobile; hanging avatar interaction becomes static on touch devices.

3d_libraries.decision: Prefer 2D CSS/SVG for this portfolio to protect GitHub Pages performance. Optional R3F/Drei only for a lazy-loaded decorative layer, with Suspense and a static fallback; no core content in 3D.
steps: Lazy-load decorative scene only after first content paint
Use transparent canvas and adequate ambient/key lighting
Pause or remove scene under reduced motion and on low-power/mobile contexts

implementation_instructions.framework: React JavaScript files (.js), Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui primitives, FastAPI optional/static-friendly
implementation_instructions.forms: Use shadcn Input/Sheet/Dialog where needed; contact is display-only with mailto/tel links and no pretend submission.
implementation_instructions.assistant: Local predefined WEB AI assistant only; answer from data_content, disclose scope, and never call an external model or expose keys.
implementation_instructions.zip: Provide a real downloadable ZIP generated from the complete source at build/runtime; label it clearly and handle failure with an accessible error state.
implementation_instructions.testing: Add stable data-testid attributes and verify mobile nav, skip startup, reduced motion, keyboard dossiers, assistant, copy buttons, tel/mailto, and ZIP download.

GENERAL_UI_UX_DESIGN_GUIDELINES: Avoid generic centered layouts, SaaS cards, uniform columns, and decorative gradient overload.
Use generous spacing, asymmetry, layered z-index depth, crisp borders, and emotionally directed sections.
Every interactive control needs hover, active, focus, and reduced-motion-safe feedback.
Use explicit text colors on hover and focus; primary crimson is reserved for actions.
Never use emoji as icons; use the existing icon library or simple SVG line icons.
Do not use transition: all; transition specific properties only.
Keep mobile-first behavior, readable left-aligned content, and desktop navigation links visible.
instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the Web-Slinger Command Deck direction first. Make the supplied Spider man 1.webp the unmistakable opening image, then let accurate evidence and contact information carry the narrative. Preserve static-friendly behavior, accessibility, and maintainable data-driven arrays over hardcoded repeated markup.
